assessment_objectives.objective: Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities are granted read-only permissions limited to the resources required for control validation.
Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities are prohibited from holding write and/or administrative permissions on the Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) they assess.
requests for permissions beyond read-only access for a Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identity are denied or, where an exception is granted, are documented, risk-assessed and approved.
permissions assigned to Control Assurance Automation (CAA) automated identities are reviewed at a defined frequency to confirm they remain read-only and least privilege.
